An '''Ignition Charge''' was a component used on [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]]. It was located beneath the [[homing sensor]] on the tip of the [[Missile/Legends|projectile]], and above the [[proton-scattering energy warhead]].<ref name="EGWT" />
